compatibilityDecisions.decision: Installed Effect 4.0.2 and native Alchemy beta81 APIs checked against local declarations; runtime support consumes Effect only.

Adapt the canonical Effect-service renderer to TaxKit compiled runtime support: repository source condition and catalogue dependencies, existing root TypeScript configuration, focused host identity and observation exports with no ceremonial service contract. Installed Effect 4.0.2 typecheck/build and four controlled privacy/event/edge admission tests pass.

limitations: Structural rendering does not prove installed dependency, declaration, runtime, or packed-consumer behavior.

The native Alchemy class and binding types are deployment-only infrastructure exports. Source-only provider settings are outside this package; package tests do not establish native bundle contents or remote ingestion.
nonClaims: Selected versions are not claimed to remain latest.
